answer: The protocol issues a time‑locked cryptographic cipher token (the “gale token”) to each newly registered agent, encrypted with a yarrow‑seeded randomness round that only a verified bootstrap node can generate. The token vests linearly over a 30‑day epoch, and any reward claim requires the agent to present the current token hash; each new identity must post a stake of 10 PoA credits that is slashed if the vesting schedule is aborted.
